card.name: Last piece of repeated drug brand names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name when the name is being repeated, often after 'or' or 'and' for a second formulation such as oral solution or XR. Also fires on the end of generic names like ivabradine or nateglinide.

modes.label: Repeated brand name, second form
modes.description: Final piece of a brand name written a second time for another formulation such as XR, PED, PD or sprinkle.

modes.label: End of generic drug name
modes.description: Last piece of a generic name just before a dosage form like tablets or oral solution.
